program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (has-color? color colors)
      (any? (lambda (c) (= c color)) colors))
    (define (color-order cells acc)
      (if (empty? cells)
          (reverse acc)
          (let ((v (third (first cells))))
            (if (or (= v 0) (has-color? v acc))
                (color-order (cdr cells) acc)
                (color-order (cdr cells) (cons v acc))))))
    (define colors (color-order (grid-cells g) (list)))
    (define (rect-for color)
      (let ((cells (find-color g color)))
        (if (= (length cells) 2)
            (let* ((a (first cells))
                   (b (second cells))
                   (r0 (min (fst a) (fst b)))
                   (r1 (max (fst a) (fst b)))
                   (c0 (min (snd a) (snd b)))
                   (c1 (max (snd a) (snd b))))
              (if (and (not (= r0 r1)) (not (= c0 c1)))
                  (list color r0 c0 r1 c1)
                  #f))
            #f)))
    (define rects (filter (lambda (x) x) (map rect-for colors)))
    (define (on-border? r c rect)
      (let ((r0 (second rect)) (c0 (third rect)) (r1 (fourth rect)) (c1 (nth rect 4)))
        (and (>= r r0) (<= r r1) (>= c c0) (<= c c1)
             (or (= r r0) (= r r1) (= c c0) (= c c1)))))
    (define (border-color r c)
      (foldl
        (lambda (rect acc)
          (if (on-border? r c rect) (first rect) acc))
        #f
        rects))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        (let ((bc (border-color r c)))
          (if bc bc (cell-at g r c)))))))
